paragraphs.text:
You are well-traveled enough to know that the two men are 
concealing handguns at their waists. What they could possibly 
need them for is beyond you, but their hidden weapons and 
shady nature make you think it isn’t good.

Before you turn to go, you think you catch a glint of metal 
from beneath the folds of the young man’s coat as well. This 
man might likewise be armed.
